beats.label: The data
beats.text: **111,000+** adults tracked for more than **30 years** at Harvard.
beats.note: Han, Hu et al., BMJ Medicine 2026

beats.label: One activity
beats.text: Some mostly stuck to **one** thing, like walking or running.

beats.label: A mix
beats.text: Others spread time across **many,** from weights to yoga to **gardening.**

beats.label: The gap
beats.text: Most variety vs. least: about **19%** lower risk of **early death.**

beats.label: The twist
beats.text: The link showed up at **every** activity level, not just for big exercisers.

beats.label: Reality check
beats.text: Self-reported habits, mostly **white** health workers. A **link,** not proof, and switching routines wasn't tested.
Follow for one **workout myth** a week, checked against **cohorts.**
